description: This file defines a PHP trait called EncryptionTraitV2 within the Aws\Crypto namespace. The trait provides methods for encrypting data streams using various cipher options, facilitating encrypted storage and transmission in AWS SDK context. It includes internal methods for building cipher methods and obtaining encryption streams, handling cipher metadata, and integrating with materials providers.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Builds an encryption stream for given plaintext, populates encryption metadata into the provided envelope, and manages cipher parameters, including key generation and IV setup, supporting cipher validation and compliance with AWS encryption standards.

methods.name: getEncryptingStream
methods.description: Creates and returns an encryption stream that wraps the plaintext using specified cipher options, supporting only 'gcm' cipher currently, and provides cryptographic parameter handling such as Tag length and IV.
